raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

The following table shows special cases that in part differ from the normal situation in Contract Accounts Receivable and
Payable, and where you should therefore take special care.

Function

Search Helps

Revenue Distribution

Note

If the user does not have authorization for displaying blocked business partners, the
system does not display blocked business partners in the list of results for business
partner search helps. Other seach helps, such as search helps for the contract account,
suppress personal data in the results list.

If you use classic or enhanced revenue distribution, be aware that it is not possible to tell
directly from the business partner master record or the contract account of a business
partner, if the business partner is used as the final recipient for classic or enhanced
revenue distribution.

In the transaction Check Bus. Partner Can Be Blocked (FPDPR1), which checks if
business partners can be blocked, therefore does not check if a business partner is the

final recipient for a revenue distribution and if open items still exist or distributions are
still outstanding that contain this business partner or one of her contract accounts as the
final recipient. The program only checks if there are still open items for a business
partner. If no more business takes place, the business partner is blocked once the
residence period has expired. This has the following effects:

e For business partners used in many documents as final recipient, regular clearing
of documents by executing the mass activity Distribute Revenues (transaction

FP60M), or the mass activity Post Distribution Document, or Distribute
Revenues: Create and Post Documents (transaction FP6@P) regularly result in
new distribution documents on the final recipient's account. You can prevent
unintentional blocking of a final recipient by transaction Check Bus. Partner Can
Be Blocked and subsequent execution of transaction Blocking of Business

Partner Data (BUPA_PRE_EOP) by choosing a residence period that is long
enough and executing the mass activity for revenue distribution and posting ona

regular basis.

e If abusiness partner is used as a final recipient in only one or very few documents
(for example, in the case of a government agency requesting assistance from
another government agency) and if the documents were not cleared over a long
period or if clearings were reset, then, despite the revenue distribution programs

being run, no new postings are generated on the account of the final recipient. If
the defined residence period has expired, transaction Check Bus. Partner Can

Be Blocked and the subsequent execution of transaction Blocking of Business
Partner Data (BUPA_PRE_EOP) can block the final recipient unintentionally,
although there are still open documents for this final recipient. To prevent this,
you should choose a residence period that is long enough, and clear the
documents during this period (for example, by writing them off) if it is to be
expected that invoices will not be paid in cases of inter-agency assistance.

—> Recommendation

To be able not to block certain final recipients at all, or to run special checks
for them, create your own customer-specific application object for the final
recipient and implement your own check of the end of purpose for this
application object. Assign a separate application rule variant to this
application object in Customizing.
